label: Drywall / interiors
disclaimer: LPIN drywall / interiors trade pack — field guidance only. Not an AHJ form, not a live code library, not legal advice. A person owns every status, hold clear, and inspection call. Confirm adopted edition and inspection sequence with the local building department.

items.text: Nail plates and blocking in place
GC pre-rock walk complete (no verbal only)
Board type and thickness per schedule
Joints and corners ready for tape
No covering of uncleared rough work

holdPoints.label: Pre-rock clear before hang
holdPoints.notes: Verbal pre-rock is invalid — documented clear required.

sequence.typicalPhase: After MEP rough and pre-rock clear
sequence.notes: Enforces GC pre-rock. Verbal clear is not accepted.

safetyPhrases.phrase: Hanging board over uncleared MEP rough or without documented pre-rock.
Dust control inadequate in occupied or adjacent spaces.
Board type or thickness mismatch stops hang sequence.

readinessCriteria: Board and fasteners on site and correct
Inspection points still open until hang starts

interviewSlots.prompt: What stops the crew immediately on a drywall job?
What must prior trades hand you before drywall work starts cleanly?
What must be clear before the next trade covers or depends on your work?
Which inspections or super clears are non-negotiable before conceal or handoff?
Which material lines most often delay your critical path?
What photos do you take so a remote super understands the condition?
When do you actually call inspection or declare ready — plain language?
